original_test_intent: Verify physical OAM_7 power consumption is valid and consistently reported by Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Prove final-member OAM_7 attribution, map equivalent power domains, capture synchronized readings in a declared state, preserve validity/status, normalize windows/units and evaluate population, range and deltas including negative and over-limit anomalies.
manual_activity: Power owner confirms OAM_7 identity/domain and validity/range rules and owns anomaly disposition.
required_inputs: Operating state, units, ranges, deltas and freshness
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection and no unapproved load
Verify OAM_7 final member and full response counts
Never coerce invalid values into range
Stop on missing, negative, over-limit, stale or unmatched data
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity/member presence and raw status
Normalize comparable fresh channels and calculate approved differences
Report independently without aggregate pass or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The resource is relevant, but an insecure single metric cannot satisfy all interfaces or detect final-member/invalid-value loss.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture mapped OAM_7 power from all required surfaces, retain validity and member counts, and compare fresh equivalent metrics against approved limits.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_7 and the source-required read-only interfaces/timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use OAM_7-specific rows that retain member existence, raw status/value, physical boundary, window, time, normalized watts and every range/delta result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit tail-member and invalid-number controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No eight-OAM aggregate, RVS workload or external power calibration substitutes for this case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A plausible value alone cannot prove correct attribution or validity.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines OAM_7 valid ranges and whether firmware sentinel values represent missing, offline or sensor failure.
expected_evidence: Full redacted Redfish/IPMI/ROCm data with statuses/counts
Logs, anomaly decisions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests OAM_7 multi-source power parity; DeepSeek is incomplete rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mappings, oracle and access can be provided.

review_improvement: Adds final-member and invalid-range controls so OAM_7 cannot pass through enumeration truncation or numeric coercion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Tail collection elements are vulnerable to off-by-one truncation, and parsers sometimes coerce null, negative sentinel or overflow values into ordinary numbers. OAM_7 evidence must prove the member was actually present on every surface and retain raw validity before normalization. A system aggregate cannot demonstrate this module-specific coverage.
